entries.text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
entries.source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

entries.text: You see Brother Thomas.
entries.source_text: You see Brother Thomas.

entries.text: 你看到托马斯兄弟。
entries.source_text: 你看到托马斯兄弟。

entries.text: Okay children. Today we will be going over some martial arts.
entries.source_text: Okay children. Today we will be going over some martial arts.

entries.text: 好的孩子。今天我们将学习一些搏斗技巧。
entries.source_text: 好的孩子。今天我们将学习一些搏斗技巧。

entries.text: In close combat the technique you use depends on your# opponents size, reach, and quickness.
entries.source_text:
In close combat the technique you use depends on your
# opponents size, reach, and quickness.

entries.text: 在近战中使用什么技巧取决于你对手的大小，距离和速度。
entries.source_text: 在近战中使用什么技巧取决于你对手的大小，距离和速度。

entries.text: If given the opportunity test your opponent.
entries.source_text: If given the opportunity test your opponent.

entries.text: 如果给你试探对手的机会。
entries.source_text: 如果给你试探对手的机会。

entries.text: Don't rush the attack.
entries.source_text: Don't rush the attack.

entries.text: 不要急于进攻。
entries.source_text: 不要急于进攻。

entries.text: All right my little one, try to hurt poor old gramps.
entries.source_text: All right my little one, try to hurt poor old gramps.

entries.text: 来吧小伙子们，和我这个老头子较量较量。
entries.source_text: 来吧小伙子们，和我这个老头子较量较量。

entries.text: Ah!
entries.source_text: Ah!

entries.text: 啊！
entries.source_text: 啊！

entries.text: Uhh.
entries.source_text: Uhh.

entries.text: 噢。
entries.source_text: 噢。

entries.text: Well that's all for now, so let's review.
entries.source_text: Well that's all for now, so let's review.

entries.text: 人都到齐了，我们开始复习。
entries.source_text: 人都到齐了，我们开始复习。

entries.text: You see how he lost his balance?
entries.source_text: You see how he lost his balance?

entries.text: 你们看到他刚才怎么失去平衡了吧？
entries.source_text: 你们看到他刚才怎么失去平衡了吧？

entries.text: Overextending yourself leaves you open for a counter attack.
entries.source_text: Overextending yourself leaves you open for a counter attack.

entries.text: 动作太大反而使你受到攻击。
entries.source_text: 动作太大反而使你受到攻击。

entries.text: When you attack be sure not to overextend.
entries.source_text: When you attack be sure not to overextend.

entries.text: 当你进攻时最好不要动作幅度太大。
entries.source_text: 当你进攻时最好不要动作幅度太大。

entries.text: Why is overextending so bad?
entries.source_text: Why is overextending so bad?

entries.text: 为什么动作幅度太大不好？
entries.source_text: 为什么动作幅度太大不好？

entries.text: If you have the opportunity for a kill, shouldn't you go for it?
entries.source_text: If you have the opportunity for a kill, shouldn't you go for it?

entries.text: 如果你有一个机会杀死对方，你会不去做吗？
entries.source_text: 如果你有一个机会杀死对方，你会不去做吗？

entries.text: That's a lot to risk your life over.
entries.source_text: That's a lot to risk your life over.

entries.text: 那是一个致命的危险。
entries.source_text: 那是一个致命的危险。

entries.text: Overextending leaves your inside vulnerable to a counter attack# and puts you off balance.
entries.source_text:
Overextending leaves your inside vulnerable to a counter attack
# and puts you off balance.

entries.text: 动作幅度太大的话，你的弱点就被暴露，对方也会轻易的把你打倒。
entries.source_text: 动作幅度太大的话，你的弱点就被暴露，对方也会轻易的把你打倒。

entries.text: One little shove will land you right on your ass.
entries.source_text: One little shove will land you right on your ass.

entries.text: 轻轻一推你就会屁股落地。
entries.source_text: 轻轻一推你就会屁股落地。

entries.text: Okay, let's give another young punk a try at gramps.
entries.source_text: Okay, let's give another young punk a try at gramps.

entries.text: 好，让我们给另外一个壮汉与老头子较量的机会。
entries.source_text: 好，让我们给另外一个壮汉与老头子较量的机会。

entries.text: Let's see if you've learned from the previous example.
entries.source_text: Let's see if you've learned from the previous example.

entries.text: 让我们看看你以前学过的是什么？
entries.source_text: 让我们看看你以前学过的是什么？

entries.text: Not bad, that last move almost got me.
entries.source_text: Not bad, that last move almost got me.

entries.text: 不错，你快要打到我了。
entries.source_text: 不错，你快要打到我了。

entries.text: Are you sure you want to be a Scribe Initiate?
entries.source_text: Are you sure you want to be a Scribe Initiate?

entries.text: 你真的打算做一个初级研究员？
entries.source_text: 你真的打算做一个初级研究员？

entries.text: Those talents would be a shame to waste.
entries.source_text: Those talents would be a shame to waste.

entries.text: 天赋被浪费是个耻辱。
entries.source_text: 天赋被浪费是个耻辱。

entries.text: We'll just keep you in reserve. Okay?
entries.source_text: We'll just keep you in reserve. Okay?

entries.text: 我们将会让你继续留在预备役。怎么样？
entries.source_text: 我们将会让你继续留在预备役。怎么样？

entries.text: I'm just fooling with ya.
entries.source_text: I'm just fooling with ya.

entries.text: 我只是开个玩笑。
entries.source_text: 我只是开个玩笑。

entries.text: You may want to reconsider a career as a Knight.
entries.source_text: You may want to reconsider a career as a Knight.

entries.text: 应该考虑成为一名骑士。
entries.source_text: 应该考虑成为一名骑士。

entries.text: Just think about it.
entries.source_text: Just think about it.

entries.text: 考虑考虑。
entries.source_text: 考虑考虑。

entries.text: Thank you Brother Thomas.
entries.source_text: Thank you Brother Thomas.

entries.text: 谢谢你托马斯兄弟。
entries.source_text: 谢谢你托马斯兄弟。

entries.text: I hope you all noticed how Brother Anthony did not overextend# himself.
entries.source_text:
I hope you all noticed how Brother Anthony did not overextend
# himself.

entries.text: 我希望你仔细学习安东尼兄弟是怎么小幅度动作进行进攻的。
entries.source_text: 我希望你仔细学习安东尼兄弟是怎么小幅度动作进行进攻的。

entries.text: He also tried to use my weight and bulkiness against me.
entries.source_text: He also tried to use my weight and bulkiness against me.

entries.text: 他还知道怎么利用我的身材庞大和体重来进攻。
entries.source_text: 他还知道怎么利用我的身材庞大和体重来进攻。

entries.text: Martial arts have their good and bad sides.
entries.source_text: Martial arts have their good and bad sides.

entries.text: 搏斗技巧有好的一面和坏的一面。
entries.source_text: 搏斗技巧有好的一面和坏的一面。

entries.text: We will be learning many different styles to better understand# their strengths and weaknesses.
entries.source_text:
We will be learning many different styles to better understand
# their strengths and weaknesses.

entries.text: 我们将会学习一些不同的流派，来更好的了解它们的力道和不足之处。
entries.source_text: 我们将会学习一些不同的流派，来更好的了解它们的力道和不足之处。

entries.text: Okay. Show me what you've got.
entries.source_text: Okay. Show me what you've got.

entries.text: 好。让我看看你学的如何。
entries.source_text: 好。让我看看你学的如何。

entries.text: Very good. You lasted much longer than I thought you would.
entries.source_text: Very good. You lasted much longer than I thought you would.

entries.text: 非常好。你坚持的事件比我料想的还长。
entries.source_text: 非常好。你坚持的事件比我料想的还长。

entries.text: You can go back to the line.
entries.source_text: You can go back to the line.

entries.text: 回到你那一排里去。
entries.source_text: 回到你那一排里去。

entries.text: Well, I hope you kids were able to catch what was going on.
entries.source_text: Well, I hope you kids were able to catch what was going on.

entries.text: 好的，我希望你们这些小子可以觉察正在发生什么事。
entries.source_text: 好的，我希望你们这些小子可以觉察正在发生什么事。

entries.text: He's a natural fighter.
entries.source_text: He's a natural fighter.

entries.text: 他是一个天生的战士。
entries.source_text: 他是一个天生的战士。

entries.text: Let's have one more.
entries.source_text: Let's have one more.

entries.text: 我们再做一些练习。
entries.source_text: 我们再做一些练习。

entries.text: Pay close attention...
entries.source_text: Pay close attention...

entries.text: 集中注意力……
entries.source_text: 集中注意力……

entries.text: and remember to always punch through your targets.
entries.source_text: and remember to always punch through your targets.

entries.text: 然后盯紧目标出拳。
entries.source_text: 然后盯紧目标出拳。

entries.text: Pretend your target is a few inches beyond were the impact is# going to be.
entries.source_text:
Pretend your target is a few inches beyond were the impact is
# going to be.

entries.text: 假设你的目标是一些球从远处飞来。
entries.source_text: 假设你的目标是一些球从远处飞来。

entries.text: Um, Brother Thomas?
entries.source_text: Um, Brother Thomas?

entries.text: 嗯，托马斯兄弟？
entries.source_text: 嗯，托马斯兄弟？

entries.text: Yes, my little piece of clay.
entries.source_text: Yes, my little piece of clay.

entries.text: 是的，我的小伙子。
entries.source_text: 是的，我的小伙子。

entries.text: Shouldn't we do that for kicking too?
entries.source_text: Shouldn't we do that for kicking too?

entries.text: 难道我们也不能像这样去踢？
entries.source_text: 难道我们也不能像这样去踢？

entries.text: Of, course.
entries.source_text: Of, course.

entries.text: 嗯，过程。
entries.source_text: 嗯，过程。

entries.text: Very good. I think we'll let you live.
entries.source_text: Very good. I think we'll let you live.

entries.text: 很好。我想我应该让你在这里。
entries.source_text: 很好。我想我应该让你在这里。

entries.text: Just kidding, try to smile once in a while.
entries.source_text: Just kidding, try to smile once in a while.

entries.text: 利用微笑让对手放松警惕。
entries.source_text: 利用微笑让对手放松警惕。

entries.text: This isn't a life and death situation.
entries.source_text: This isn't a life and death situation.

entries.text: 这不是生死之战。
entries.source_text: 这不是生死之战。

entries.text: There'll be plenty of time for that later on.
entries.source_text: There'll be plenty of time for that later on.

entries.text: 以后还有更多的机会。
entries.source_text: 以后还有更多的机会。

entries.text: Not bad.
entries.source_text: Not bad.

entries.text: 不错。
entries.source_text: 不错。

entries.text: That was pretty good.
entries.source_text: That was pretty good.

entries.text: 做的漂亮。
entries.source_text: 做的漂亮。

entries.text: Okay, you're learning.
entries.source_text: Okay, you're learning.

entries.text: 好，你正在学习。
entries.source_text: 好，你正在学习。

entries.text: Stay focused.
entries.source_text: Stay focused.

entries.text: 集中精神。
entries.source_text: 集中精神。

entries.text: Keep your eyes on me.
entries.source_text: Keep your eyes on me.

entries.text: 盯着我。
entries.source_text: 盯着我。

entries.text: Don't overextend.
entries.source_text: Don't overextend.

entries.text: 动作幅度不要太大。
entries.source_text: 动作幅度不要太大。

entries.text: Never look away from your opponent.
entries.source_text: Never look away from your opponent.

entries.text: 盯紧你的对手。
entries.source_text: 盯紧你的对手。

entries.text: Work on your blocks.
entries.source_text: Work on your blocks.

entries.text: 注意脚下。
entries.source_text: 注意脚下。

entries.text: Keep your center of gravity low.
entries.source_text: Keep your center of gravity low.

entries.text: 压低你的重心。
entries.source_text: 压低你的重心。

entries.text: Excellent!
entries.source_text: Excellent!

entries.text: 非常好！
entries.source_text: 非常好！

entries.text: Perfect form.
entries.source_text: Perfect form.

entries.text: 保持正确姿势！
entries.source_text: 保持正确姿势！

entries.text: I'm impressed.
entries.source_text: I'm impressed.

entries.text: 我记住了。
entries.source_text: 我记住了。

entries.text: You gain 500 experience points from watching the training.
entries.source_text: You gain 500 experience points from watching the training.
